title: Rav Kahana son of Rav Nechunya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rav Yehudah’s attendant, as stated explicitly in [Taanit 24b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.24b.3).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rav Kahana son of Rav Nechunya as Rav Yehudah’s attendant. The sages ask him to get Rav Yehudah to go out by the market.
